result.summary: Found 1 minor styling and usability issue where the wrong tab is highlighted in the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Profile' tab is highlighted in green as the active state, even though the screen currently displayed is clearly the 'Home' feed.
issues.suggestion: Update the bottom navigation bar state logic so that the 'Home' tab icon and label are highlighted in green when the user is on the main home screen, and set 'Profile' to the inactive gray state.
